title: Chapter 32 Repairing The Portal
content:
Chapter 32 Repairing The Portal

There are some broken walls scattered around, it seems that they were destroyed by violence.

[I found the broken entrance to the Void Battlefield. Will it be repaired? 】

Wang Shuo tried to repair it.

[Repair the void battlefield portal: void shuttle stone 1/1, stone 555/100, energy crystal 1832/500]

After thinking for a long time, Wang Shuo agreed to repair it. After all, in this game world where people are struggling to survive, blindly giving in is not a good choice.

[The Void Battlefield portal is under repair and is expected to take 48 hours. 】

Wang Shuo also used the terrain changing scroll to transform this entire area into land. After all, he would visit this place frequently in the future.

After doing this, the system prompts again:

[You have completely controlled the territory, and the fog disappears within the territory. 】

In an instant, the sky brightened, and he saw the long-lost sun in the sky.

Wang Shuo felt that the oppressive atmosphere before disappeared without a trace in an instant.

Even breathing became much easier.

Back home, the inner wall around the residence was also built.

It was thicker than before, giving Wang Shuo a huge sense of security.

Tomorrow we will build the outer walls and build a few more arrow towers and energy towers, which will make it safer.

Wang Shuo came to the workshop and made another 1,000 bronze keys. Currently, Wang Shuo is not the only one selling keys in the trading house, but the price of the keys has not dropped and remains at 2 gold coins.

Wang Shuo's gold coins also exceeded 200 again, and he hung up another 100 keys.

After doing this, he was so sleepy that he quickly fell asleep.

The next morning, Wang Shuo continued to burn the kiln to make fire bricks. He also took the time to make the excess cotton into cotton-padded clothes, quilts and other materials. He also put some unused materials such as adobe bricks and tiles into the trading house. .

By noon, these supplies brought Wang Shuo another 600 gold coins.

By this time, he had accumulated 854 gold coins and 40,000 fire bricks. At this moment, the system prompt sounded:

[You have made a total of 50,000 pieces of pottery and understood the ceramic making process. 】

Wang Shuo opened the "Synthesis Formula".

There are many more ceramic synthesis formulas in it.

There are porcelain bowls, porcelain plates, etc.

Not long after, the system reminded him that his "Harmony Mud" skill had also been upgraded.

[Heli Mud: Level 3, consumes 2 points of spiritual power, used on a 10 cubic meter mud pit or silt field to separate the soil and water, and obtain clay and water. No skill CD. 】

This time, the speed at which he obtained the clay was greatly accelerated again.

It’s an unexpected surprise!

The number of fire bricks required to build all the outer walls is about 100,000.

There is also a lot of other cement and sand, and there is no way to collect them all today.

He chose to build the south, north, and west walls first.

He now has six kilns and can make 60,000 fire bricks in one day.

He worked until evening to build a wall of 20,000 bricks. Excluding the fire bricks exchanged for cement, he still has 60,000 bricks in his warehouse.

…

Early the next morning, Wang Shuo discovered that there was an additional task in the [Task] column.

2. Hope is at dawn.

There will be a huge flood on the morning of the 13th (three days later), so all players should be prepared.

When Wang Shuo saw this mission, his face looked grim. Combined with the prediction in the "diary", it seemed that this flood was not simple.

With an uneasy feeling, he first checked the void battlefield portal.

On a huge stone platform, a 3-meter-high and 5-meter-wide starry sky gate stood in front of me, shining with dazzling brilliance.

Taking a step forward again, there is a system prompt:

【Are you entering the void battlefield? 】

Wang Shuo did not step in. Since the flood was coming, Wang Shuo still planned to build the wall first, which might be able to fight against the flood.

And what was inside the star gate made him a little afraid.

At this time, the crops in the backyard can also be harvested.

[Tomato +50, Wheat +100, Rice +100]

I sow some seeds conveniently, so that I can harvest again 2 days later.

Returning to his residence, he packed his backpack.

Yesterday he felt that his backpack was not enough.

So I found the "synthetic formula" for an intermediate backpack.

[Intermediate backpack: 20 coarse cloth + 2 ropes]

Each intermediate backpack can provide 200 grids, and these materials are a piece of cake for Wang Shuo now.

Made directly.

[Intermediate backpack +1]

…

I made 6 of them in one go, it was so awesome.

Directly increase the number of system backpacks to 1220 grids.

At this time, in the trading house, the items that Wang Shuo consigned yesterday were basically cleared, and he got another 170 gold coins.

As a result, his total gold coins reached 1,024, as well as more than 900 bronze keys.

He wanted to accumulate more funds and summoned the Travelers.

So another 200 keys were hung up in the trading house.

Then I got back into the work of firing bricks and building a fence.

Wang Shuo currently has level 3 mud and clay skills, and his ability to collect clay is very strong.

There is plenty of time to bake 60,000 fire bricks every day.

And building a wall is very simple, just like putting the bricks in your backpack directly on the wall.

In this way, Wang Shuo filled the six brick kilns with clay again in the morning, and continued to build the wall in the afternoon.

Wang Shuo used 10,000 of the 30,000 fire bricks made today to exchange for cement.

It only took one day for Wang Shuo to build the wall.

Looking at the huge project in front of him, Wang Shuo couldn't believe that he could build a 3-meter-high wall in two days.

This is not much worse than the infrastructure maniac. The survival system of survivors is indeed like a sparrow pecking a cow's butt - the sparrow eats the cow.

In the evening, Wang Shuo enjoyed the food while thinking about future plans.

He was also a little uneasy in his heart. Is the wall he built useful? Seeing the "torrential flood", he was not confident for a while.

He had seen the biggest flood, but it submerged an entire city, leaving only a few of the highest landmarks.

This horrifying scene is still fresh in Wang Shuo's memory.

To be on the safe side, Wang Shuo felt that he should accumulate more funds and summon peddlers before the flood came to see if there was a better way.

Open the [Backpack], now I finally have time, I can study it carefully, the harvest of killing the bronze boss.

[Flame Spear Construction Blueprint (one-time consumption blueprint): 1 refined iron ingot + 1 mithril + 1 ironwood, requires one flame rune enchantment. 】

Wang Shuo was stunned when he saw the introduction of this blueprint.

I have never heard of the first three materials, so you can imagine how difficult it is to obtain them.

I have heard of the last flame rune enchantment from the mercenary Wang Yanbing, but I have no idea what it is!

This is very difficult!

I had no choice but to put the blueprint into the backpack, and took out the treasure map fragments and observed them carefully.

On an unknown animal skin, a very abstract pattern was painted with black raw materials, and some mountains and rivers were vaguely visible.

Wang Shuo naturally didn't know what these terrains represented, and he studied for a long time but got nothing.

If he could collect the three incomplete treasure maps, he should be able to get some useful clues.

Finally, he remembered that he also got a skill book: Eye of Delusion.

After clicking on "Learn", open the character information and find this skill.

[Eye of Delusion: A reconnaissance skill that can detect information about wild monsters and players, see through illusions, resist enchantment, and can be upgraded. ]

This is a good skill. Is there a fox demon in this world that can cast enchantment spells?

Wang Shuo couldn't help but think about it. If he could catch a few and keep them as pets, that would be great. Tsk tsk...
